outcome: Ventriculo/hemispheric ratio (V/HR) reference values (medians and 95th percentiles)
Evans ratio reference values (medians and 95th percentiles)
Reliability (ICC) of V/HR and Evans ratio
cohort: 1595 neurologically healthy neonates born or hospitalized at Hunan Provincial Maternal and Child Health Care Hospital and Yueyang Maternal and Child Health Hospital, who were 1-7 days old at the time of data collection.
finding: The study established reference values (medians and 95th percentiles) for LV/HR, RV/HR, and Evans ratio, and found that the medians and 95th percentiles of V/HR and Evans ratio were not correlated with gestational age, birth weight, or neonate age.
mod_finding: The V/HR median and Evans ratio median were positively correlated with cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected when neonates were 1 to 7 days old.
birth_weight: N/A (measured as a covariate, but no specific weight range for inclusion is provided)
